arStrings.szText: Gain an additional passive bonus for each Druid form.

Gain an additional passive bonus for each Druid form:

{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_gold}Human{/c}: {c_random}[(Affix."Static Value 0"+Affix_Value_1)*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to Distant enemies.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_gold}Werewolf{/c}: {c_random}[(Affix."Static Value 1"+Affix_Value_1)*100|x%|]{/c} increased Critical Strike Damage to Close enemies.
{icon:bullet,1.2} {c_gold}Werebear{/c}: {c_random}[(Affix."Static Value 2"+Affix_Value_1)*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage while you have {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
